payload.title: capture-video-posters should refresh the page it captured for
payload.description: papyrus stories capture-video-posters stores the posters but the page keeps showing the flat placeholder until someone separately runs 'papyrus ops content update-live --story LINEAGE' (publish answers 'unchanged (published version N)' and does not reproject). Found 2026-11-09 on the first real ::video story. Make capture-video-posters finish with the story's update-live (or at least print the exact command), and make publish for an unchanged version say how to refresh. Gherkin: 'Capturing posters makes the page show them' and 'Publishing an unchanged version points to update-live'.
